summary: Dispatch, run-status, committed-slice integration, coordination preflight, and runtime-blocker-taxonomy tools.

tools.notes: Start a canonical unit, or dispatch a reviewer or redteam by canonical subject. Omitting role starts the unit as its dispatch_intent.intended_agent_role; task, scope, acceptance, validation, material and runtime come from the canonical unit and authenticated launcher facts, so a caller-authored prompt, request, argv or env refuses. Readiness runs internally; workspace_validate_dispatch remains available for an explicit "can this start?" question and is not a required pre-call. Managed workers require an explicit existing canonical implementation slice, even for a one-slice WK; dispatch never creates or selects one. The root WK must select base_branch before first allocation (frozen after); if missing, dispatch refuses with field guidance; edit the root with fresh CAS and resubmit. Reviews use empty write_scope and the same dispatcher; no external reviewer, shell, wrapper or alternate transport. backend_unavailable fails closed. Supply an already-known WK or slice plus diff_base_sha/reviewed_sha for exact review; no WK is inferred from a SHA. Implementation needs complete or opted-out proof posture; reviews can precede authoring. Caller identity/policy carriers refuse.
use_when: Start a known canonical implementation slice: name the unit and omit role.
The dispatch_role_call intent names a known subject and an advisory role (reviewer or redteam), which the caller chooses rather than the reviewed unit.
do_not_use_when: The task asks the prospective question of whether a unit could start rather than asking to start it; use workspace_validate_dispatch.
The task asks about an existing run; use workspace_agent_run_status.
requires_prior_state: Known canonical subject; role is optional and is derived from the unit's dispatch_intent when omitted.
No prior workspace_validate_dispatch call: readiness runs inside dispatch through its existing owner, and an earlier assessment neither replaces that check nor grants launch permission.

recommended_first_call.operation: start a known canonical unit by subject, omitting role

paid_cce.notes: Dispatch a worker, reviewer or redteam by canonical subject such as WK-<id>#SLICE-<id>; a commit SHA is only a review locator; no WK is inferred or searched from a SHA. The same registered workspace_agent_dispatch performs the review; no external reviewer, shell command, wrapper, alternate transport, terminal candidate, attestation append, or provenance repair is needed. Reviewer accepts a WK or slice; redteam also accepts an IN. Reviewer and redteam never enter worker readiness; invalid review material refuses as agent_launch.advisory_review.material_invalid.v1. Locators grant no lifecycle authority. Managed workers require an explicit existing canonical implementation slice, even for a one-slice WK; dispatch never creates or selects one; a non-dispatchable worker refuses with work_record_readiness_failure. Role configuration selects app and model; app is an assertion, an explicit model applies only where the role binding permits, and a mismatch refuses without family fallback. Caller identity carriers refuse. A valid worker_admission.recovery.v1 object is advisory, resubmission-only guidance; invalid recovery fails closed, and reason facts without one report no supported route.

tools.notes: Subject-addressed observation for workspace_agent_dispatch. Closed input: repo, subject, optional attempt_id, timeout_ms 1..300000 (omitted observes once; timeout returns settled:false without cancelling), include_final_result, or one read-only detail (failure_history, attempts, proof_verification, retry_assessment, authored_document); caller identity carriers refuse. NOT read-only for a managed exact-slice worker: observation may prepare review state, integrate, move Git refs and update canonical slice status, but only by advancing an already-authorized settlement; it cannot launch, grant integration authority, or publish to forge. child_terminal means child exit; terminal:true means the COMPLETE managed run is finalized. Follow exact next_action and next_calls; completed WK findings offer one save-for-material_refs call. Worker status reports recorded explicit workspace_verify_proof calls (none_recorded is not a pass); invocation_id and proof_subject read recorded outcomes. Free/local structured_role_result.valid:false is expected non-attesting output. include_final_result stays within the inline limit; other members are read through published calls. Reads execute nothing.
use_when: The run_monitoring intent asks for status, output, failure, or completion of an already dispatched run.
do_not_use_when: The task is a new start or role launch; use workspace_agent_dispatch, which performs readiness through its existing owner.
authoritative_for: launcher run lifecycle by canonical subject and retained attempt
requires_prior_state: Canonical WK, slice, or IN dispatch subject; a monitor handle alone is not a status argument.

tools.notes: Read-only schema-backed runtime blocker taxonomy: canonical codes, categories, recovery guidance, the deterministic degraded-state mapping, and the bootstrap-state subset. Compact by default; verbose:true adds full detail and mappings. Dispatch, launcher, and coordination refusals report codes from this taxonomy rather than ad hoc strings.
use_when: A refusal or preflight reports a runtime blocker code whose category or recovery guidance is needed.
do_not_use_when: The question is whether a unit is dispatchable or how a run is progressing; the owning readiness or run-status route answers that.
authoritative_for: runtime blocker code catalog, categories, and recovery guidance

tools.notes: Read-only coordinator/orchestrator preflight: reports role, caller/session role, subject, durable write surfaces (docs/, wiki/), repo/docs/wiki writability, dispatch/validation routes, active runtime blocker codes, and a coverage disclosure naming every fact family, its evaluation origin, authoritative boundary, and local handling — evaluated_locally, projected, or not_evaluated. Proceed is scoped to them, never launch readiness; CCE policy stays CCE-owned. Use verbose:true for every fact family.
use_when: A coordinator is about to dispatch or make coordination writes and needs the mount, role, route, writeback, and capability facts together with the disclosure of which facts preflight did not evaluate.
do_not_use_when: Structural or mechanical dispatch readiness for a unit is the question; use workspace_validate_dispatch, which owns that fact.
The caller intends to supply an identity carrier, a CCE policy result, or any other authority the route must refuse.

tools.notes: Separate orchestrator continuation for exact committed-slice integration. Review evidence and dispositions are advisory; neither they nor the request authorize integration. CCE owns any configured policy gate. Paid-tier presence alone configures no gate; without one, the result reports non-audit posture. Input is closed to repo alias, canonical slice subject, and dispositions; authority carriers are rejected. The server re-derives the exact target and performs CAS-safe idempotent integration. Successful and idempotently recovered results advise resuming workspace_agent_run_status with the canonical slice subject. Refusals omit the success continuation.
use_when: A committed implementation slice is parked after review preparation and the orchestrator is ready to disposition advisory comments and request integration.
do_not_use_when: The task is to dispatch or monitor a reviewer; use workspace_agent_dispatch or workspace_agent_run_status.
The caller intends to supply a ref, SHA, receipt, policy verdict, CCE attestation, or other authority carrier.
requires_prior_state: A canonical committed implementation slice in review with launcher-owned frozen target state.

tools.notes: Orchestrator/operator continuation that hands off the exact terminal candidate. The destination comes from the main repository's Git configuration, never caller input: a remote-free repository hands off locally, agent-launch.handoffDestination selects local, git:<remote> (plain Git delivery, including a local bare repository) or hosted:<remote>, and an origin remote alone means hosted branch-and-proposal publication. Remotes without origin or a selector refuse; a failed selected destination keeps its Git cause and never falls back. Cold recovery reads only refs/agent-launch/terminal-current-v2/<WK> with a directly commit-valued target and refuses terminal_candidate_recovery_current_ref_absent when it is absent; other resolution failures keep their cause at stage candidate_resolution before any effect. Review is not an input: the candidate is published under two WK-only closeout commits; an unchanged retry changes nothing and one after a permitted WK edit replaces that publication under its old head. Handoff never merges, moves a landing base or completes the WK; landing is a human or forge action observed with workspace_wk_landing_status.
use_when: A terminal candidate is frozen and quiescent and the orchestrator is ready to request its exact forge publication.
do_not_use_when: The work record is still active, or an implementation slice or managed run is still open; finish the lifecycle first.
The task asks to merge, approve, rebase, or update an existing branch; the forge and organization policy own those.
authoritative_for: launcher-owned local, Git and hosted handoff of the exact terminal candidate
requires_prior_state: A launcher-frozen exact terminal candidate with canonical initiative assignment and a quiescent lifecycle.
A remote-free repository, an explicit agent-launch.handoffDestination selector, or an origin remote with a host-side forge credential for hosted publication.

recommended_first_call.operation: publish one WK's reviewed terminal candidate

tools.notes: Read-only observation of a WK's existing handoff after workspace_wk_forge_handoff. Reports awaiting_human_landing, landed with the authenticated landed-publication carrier, contradictory, or unavailable, each with its original cause. Local and Git landing is read from the actual base history against the exact handed-off head; hosted landing from the merged proposal. Provisioning consumes the same observer. It never publishes, merges, recovers a candidate or reconciles the WK.
use_when: A WK was handed off and the coordinator needs to know whether a human has landed the exact handoff.
do_not_use_when: The task asks to land, merge or complete the WK; landing is a human or forge action and closure is its own operation.
requires_prior_state: A canonical WK whose exact terminal candidate was handed off.

recommended_first_call.operation: read one WK's handoff landing status

tools.notes: Use only for a launcher-built managed terminal candidate. Do not use for an operator-authorized direct-to-main review: commit the exact scoped candidate, then call workspace_agent_dispatch with canonical subject plus complete diff_base_sha/reviewed_sha. The reviewer is read-only and creates no Git objects.
use_when: A launcher-built managed terminal candidate may be absent, bound, stale, divergent, or healthy and the coordinator needs exact current state.
do_not_use_when: The caller intends to supply candidate, ref, SHA, path, lock, schema, or policy authority.
The lifecycle is an operator-authorized direct-to-main review; use workspace_agent_dispatch with the canonical subject and complete SHA pair after the scoped commit lands.
requires_prior_state: A canonical WK id in the selected workspace.

tools.notes: Closed-input continuation for a stale-W candidate only. The launcher re-evaluates status inside its per-WK exclusion, derives the candidate, and advances only refs/agent-launch/terminal-current-v2/<WK> by CAS. Input is closed to repo and wk_id; caller candidate or Git authority refuses.
use_when: workspace_terminal_review_candidate_status returns candidate_stale_w and its exact next_call names this route.
do_not_use_when: Status is absent, invalid, bound, coordination-inadmissible, divergent, or healthy.
requires_prior_state: A candidate_stale_w status re-proven inside the launcher exclusion.

recommended_first_call.operation: advance the stale candidate returned by status
